verdict.rationale: BVNK documents webhooks that give real-time notifications for changes in your account. It also documents signature validation through a dedicated Webhook Signature Validator tool, and configurable event subscriptions such as `bvnk:ledger:report:ready`. Together these cover the core of signed, push-based state tracking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of payment-confirmed, payout-settled and conversion-executed event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability.
